_comment: Categories that will ship BELOW the 5-creator target because the search is finished and this is what exists. Only add an entry once you have actually stopped looking for that specific category — a domain having had one pass proves nothing. Each reason says what was searched and what was found, to the same standard as critic-gaps.json. The 5-minimum is a target the owner knowingly traded away rather than loosen the scope rule; this file is where that trade is made visible. Empty is correct until a category's search is genuinely done.

gaps.addiction-recovery: Searched deliberately under rule 12 rather than opportunistically. Probed 13 candidate handles; five resolved. Two were rejected on conflict of interest rather than quality: @TheRecoveryVillage is a physician-led rehab chain whose videos market its own admissions, and @AllenCarrsEasyway is a commercial cessation method (172 of 200 uploads under two minutes) claiming 50 million users in its own marketing. @NIDAnews turned out to be an unrelated Arabic-language news channel and @AlcoholMastery has one upload. Two were included: Addiction Policy Forum, a non-profit interviewing named researchers with nothing to sell, and Sober Powered, a coach — explicitly not a clinician — whose post-acute withdrawal material is genuinely hard to find elsewhere. The category ships at 2 rather than 5. Filling it further would mean adding rehab marketing or personal-testimony channels without clinical grounding, and in this category a bad recommendation costs more than an absent one.
